entities.summary: Mario François Duplantier is a French and American musician and artist best known as the drummer for heavy metal band Gojira. He established himself as a powerful, technically precise drummer, using polyrhythmic patterns and distinctive jazzy fills and drum breaks. He has been practising painting and drawing since 2009.
